_about: An Akamatis Smart Device (firmware 1.3.0, ESPHome 2025.5.2), read on 2026-11-01. Its name suffix (the end of its MAC address) is made up here.
txt: its _esphomelib._tcp TXT records. The real device also sends its MAC address; the mac value here is made up, so tests can check that it is dropped.
events: server-sent events from GET /events, cut to the readings Art Frames can use plus one text sensor. The text sensor holds a made-up MAC address.

entities: the same readings as the native API lists them. The web server sends no device classes; these are ESPHome's defaults for ld2410 (has_target occupancy, has_moving_target motion, has_still_target occupancy) and ltr_als_ps (ambient_light illuminance).
